OAT-06/S21.title: Double tap on task Complete and on Mark Encounter / Visit Complete: how many rows
OAT-06/S21.detail: Our own addition (the 10-15 review keeps only R2 and R4); record only. Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s21-double-tap.spec.ts on Post-Round, run twice with the same result. Hospital: a double tap on 'Complete task' writes one task_completed, but the second tap reopens the task (the chart save is optimistic, so the second tap lands on 'Reopen task'): the task ends open while a completion was counted; completing it again with one tap writes a second row (tasksCompleted +2 for one task). A double tap on Mark Encounter Complete writes one note_marked_complete (notesCompleted +1). Nursing Home: a double tap on the task's complete control writes two task_completed rows for one task (saves are not optimistic, both taps see the open task; tasksCompleted +2). A double tap on Mark Visit Complete writes one note_marked_complete (the server keeps one per chart per day). Suggestion, not a bug: count a completion once per task (debounce the control, or have the server ignore a completion of a task already done) so tasksCompleted is not inflated; the chart itself shows the physician the true state.
